title: SpaceX 已向 SEC 递交保密 IPO 申请，承销商名单曝光
summary: 知情人士透露，SpaceX 于 4 月 1 日正式提交保密 IPO 申请，高盛与摩根士丹利担任联席主承销商，目标估值区间 $3500 亿–$4000 亿美元，S-1 最快 5 月初公开。

title: SEC Clears a Path for Tokenized Stocks After Clarity Act Stumbles
summary: The "innovation exemption" lets qualifying venues trade tokenized versions of U.S. stocks on public blockchains without registering as exchanges—though it excludes price-tracking "synthetics" and lets companies block tokenization of their shares.

title: Google, Nvidia, and Anthropic want Emerald AI to find space on the grid for more data centers
summary: A new coalition that includes Google, Nvidia, Anthropic, and Emerald AI wants to find 100 GW of grid capacity for new data centers.

title: SEC grants temporary exemption for tokenized US stock trading
summary: The SEC’s Innovation Exemption allows limited tokenized US stock trading on onchain venues with trading caps and transparency requirements.

title: OpenAI discloses 6 new cases of ‘misaligned’ AI behavior
summary: The six cases are separate from July’s incident, when OpenAI models escaped containment and hacked Hugging Face during a security evaluation.

title: Musk’s long-time backer is giving SpaceX stock to its investors
summary: Valor Equity Partners is handing out stock to its LPs instead of cash returns.

title: Crypto Tax Bill Clears House Committee After Clarity Act Setback
summary: The bill would exempt qualifying crypto fees from gain-or-loss calculations and restrict tax-loss deductions on tokens sold and quickly repurchased.

title: Anthropic and OpenAI want to embed safety evaluators. Will they really be independent?
summary: Anthropic and OpenAI want to embed independent safety evaluators inside their AI labs. Researchers welcome the unprecedented access, but warn meaningful oversight requires transparency, independence, and eventually regulation.

title: OpenAI's Rogue AI Agents Were Probing Hugging Face Two Months Before Hack
summary: An independent researcher found the agents hijacked Hugging Face accounts and mapped the platform's defenses as early as May 13—activity OpenAI's own incident report never fully described.

title: Anchorage expands institutional custody to Etherlink, tokenized uranium
summary: Anchorage Digital Bank added custody support for Etherlink and several Etherlink-based assets, including xU3O8, a token representing physical uranium.

title: Circle Launches Arc Mainnet With BlackRock, DTCC and Visa as Validators
summary: The Layer 1 network’s validator set is permissioned, and Circle has minted 10 billion ARC tokens without committing to publicly launch them.

title: OpenAI老闆稱世界「應信任」AI 公司 黃仁勳籲勿作虛假取捨
summary: 希爾曼說：「如今，美國人最不信任的機構可能只有矽谷了，其次才是華盛頓。我在矽谷和華盛頓都工作過，也都生活過我可以向你保證，這種不信任都是它們自己招來的。」

title: 星宇股份解約風波：107名應屆生「告洋狀」揭示中國勞工維權現狀
summary: 9月9日，就近期在中國引起轟動的「星宇股份解約107位應屆生」事件，上交所向星宇股份下發監管工作函，港交所延緩其上市審核，此前，公司董事長周曉萍已公開道歉。
